# Reacton Fire Suppression

> > Reacton Fire Suppression provides automatic fire suppression systems for heavy equipment, vehicles, and industrial machinery using DLP (Direct Low Pressure) and ILP (Indirect Low Pressure) technologies.

Reacton specializes in P-Mark certified fire protection solutions for agriculture, mining, military vehicles, CNC machines, airport ground support equipment, and commercial kitchens. The company holds the world's first UL 2166 listing for Direct Low Pressure (DLP) technology and serves major industrial clients globally including TATA Steel and the world's largest gold mine operations.

## Key Topics

- Automatic Fire Suppression Systems
- DLP (Direct Low Pressure) Technology
- ILP (Indirect Low Pressure) Systems
- P-Mark SPCR199 Certification
- Heavy Equipment Protection
- Vehicle Fire Suppression
- CNC Machine Fire Safety
- Clean Agent Suppression
- UL 2166 Listing
- Agricultural Machinery Protection
- Military Vehicle Fire Systems
- Mining Equipment Safety
- Airport Ground Support Equipment
- Dual Agent Systems

- [Military Vehicle Fire Suppression Systems | Military Asset Protection](https://www.reactonfire.com/who-we-protect/military-vehicles): Fire suppression systems for military vehicles and defense assets
